source='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if color in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom, left, right = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, color) and (r < top or r > bottom or c < left or c > right)]
    # Markers on a side color the adjacent row/column of quadrants; the opposite
    # row/column contains the same colors in reverse order.
    vertical_side = all(r < top or r > bottom for r, c, v in markers)
    if vertical_side:
        markers.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
        a, b = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
        near_top = sum(r < top for r, c, v in markers) >= 1
        near_row_top = near_top
        mid_r, mid_c = (top + bottom + 1) // 2, (left + right + 1) // 2
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                upper = r < mid_r
                left_half = c < mid_c
                same = upper == left_half
                # The marker-imprinted row follows left-to-right marker order.
                on_near_row = upper if near_row_top else not upper
                out[r][c] = (a if left_half else b) if on_near_row else (b if left_half else a)
    else:
        markers.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
        a, b = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
        near_left = sum(c < left for r, c, v in markers) >= 1
        mid_r, mid_c = (top + bottom + 1) // 2, (left + right + 1) // 2
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                upper = r < mid_r
                left_half = c < mid_c
                on_near_col = left_half if near_left else not left_half
                out[r][c] = (a if upper else b) if on_near_col else (b if upper else a)
    return out
'''
